mode: supplementary complete-strategy source reproduction; native model trials 0
objective: Test one prespecified Faber SMA10 long/cash strategy on traded 510300 ETF against same-ETF buy-and-hold with monthly dividend cash reinvestment; risk management and net outperformance are separate claims

candidates.source: Mebane Faber 2013 A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation pp21-22
candidates.signal: Monthly last global trading-session total-return close index > simple mean of latest 10 monthly endpoints including current: target 1; < target 0; equal retain previous target. Missing endpoint: no new order, retain position and flag.
candidates.total_return: TR_d=TR_previous*(raw_close_d+cash_dividend_ex_d)/raw_close_previous. Arbitrary initial scale100 on first observed2018 close; no price forward fill. Shares split must be evidenced; any in study period stops analysis.
candidates.execution: Signal after month-end close, target executed next global trading-session open. Monthly rebalance also reinvests paid dividend cash. Missing/invalid/zero-volume/one-price bars or open at conservative +/-10% ex-dividend-adjusted prior-close boundary defer order to next eligible open; daily liquidity/fill constraints remain incomplete.

periods.exposure: 2019-2026 market history previously explored. ETF strategy outcomes not yet computed; fixed strategy/no model selection. Neither segment claimed independent unseen holdout; no future paper tracking in this batch.

account.sensitivity_split: equal commission/slippage;10bp is primary,not an additional optimized variant
account.dividends: Entitlement from registration-date end holdings; ex-date receivable marked at face value, paid cash on first global session on/after payment date. Receivable not spendable until paid. Monthly target may reinvest received cash; no withholding tax modeled.
account.terminal: Mark holdings at last raw close plus cash plus receivables; no forced liquidation. Same convention for benchmark.
account.benchmark: Always-long 510300 with same lot, execution, costs, monthly paid-dividend reinvestment and initial purchase on first evaluation open; cash0 additionally shown. Primary benchmark is traded ETF ledger,not index or NAV.

data_sources: Tencent public historical actual ETF raw OHLC/volume; hfq for discrepancy diagnostics only,not execution or units
Eastmoney fund distribution table for registry/ex/payment dates and cash amount; crosscheck NAV event dates; not NAV execution
quality.gaps: Calendar from independently observed market benchmark; unknown missing ETF date blocks execution and valuation/report unless separately resolved. No silent zero return or carrying price through unknown gaps.
limitations: Historical complete price-limit/suspension orderbook absent; stated conservative daily proxies do not certify fills
510300 chosen ex ante as established CSI300 vehicle,not all ETFs; no cross-sectional survivorship claim
Cash0 and fixed friction are assumptions,not verified broker costs or calibrated impact
Original Faber US/global study not A-share proof; original same-close execution and Treasury cash interest are changed

metrics: monthly strategy-minus-benchmark active return HAC3 CI
statistics.gate: No guarantee or single winner selection. Net performance advantage requires primary net CAGR above benchmark and monthly active-return two-sided HAC3 CI lower>0; risk reduction reported separately if max drawdown smaller. One candidate no multiplicity selection. Costs0/30 sensitivity cannot rescue primary gate.
statistics.curve: True cash/share/receivable marked portfolio daily equity, not compounded conditional group returns.
